description: SPENDS REAL MONEY from the ArisPay funding account (EUR, GBP or USD). The complete machine payment path: makes the HTTP request, and if the server answers 402 with an arispay-fiat offer, asks ArisPay to authorize the payment, retries the request, and returns the response plus a structured machine-readable receipt. ArisPay enforces the stored agent's per-tx/daily/monthly mandate and allowed domains BEFORE it authorizes. Requires an idempotencyKey: re-calling with a key that already paid returns the cached receipt and does NOT pay again. A 402 with no arispay-fiat offer is not paid and returns an error. Do not use for ordinary unpaid HTTP requests.

agent.description: Optional name of a stored agent.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-chosen unique key for this payment intent (min 8 chars, e.g. a UUID). Re-calling with a key that already paid returns the cached receipt WITHOUT paying again — except a payment the seller settled but did not deliver: re-calling within 9 minutes re-sends the SAME payment so the seller can re-serve it. Use a fresh key for each new payment intent.

url.description: The full URL of the API endpoint to call.

name: pay
